name: open-imagine
description: Direct, generate, edit and review still images with your own Open Imagine studio.

interface.shortDescription: Make photos, design, illustration and edits
interface.longDescription: Turns a brief into still images on your own Open Imagine studio, a local image, video and voice studio for Apple Silicon. It plans the shot, writes the prompt from a library of tested styles, generates, inspects the results and refines them with edits.
